assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster UI sprite for Battle Cities Unity results, not a full-page mockup. Style reference: the supplied full-screen results concept. Polished colorful cartoon 3D illustrated mobile game style, clean silhouettes, broad readable forms, small bevels, soft top-left highlights, navy edge definition. Must remain clear at 32–64 screen pixels. Output ONE isolated asset, centered, on true transparent background, no white/checkerboard/black backdrop, no text, letters, numbers, labels, watermarks or other UI elements. Tight useful framing with only a very small transparent safety margin. No long cast shadow outside the sprite. SUBJECT: one distinct confident young adult olive officer commander portrait. Head and shoulders, slightly turned toward viewer left, warm medium skin, brown eyes, strong expressive brow, neat dark hair, olive uniform collar. Rounded deep olive officer helmet with one readable raised GOLD STAR centered above forehead, subtle brown leather chin straps. Clearly a different character from the green scout. PORTRAIT FRAME: square with modest rounded corners, narrow cobalt-blue outer rim, silver bevel and thin navy inner border exactly like the four portrait thumbnails in the concept, not the gold profile frame. Rim occupies about 5% of width, identical width on all four sides. Dark moss/navy illustration backing INSIDE the frame only, opaque portrait interior and true alpha outside. Fill about 96% of a square canvas. Entire frame intact. No medals, rank digits, badges or caption.
assets.processing: Sharp: alpha-bound crop, aspect-preserving resize, transparent safety padding, lossless PNG
assets.status: Exported; alpha/dimensions validated; native-scale preview visually inspected
